title_en: Interim Provisions on the Responsibilities of Higher Education Management

articles.content_en:
I. Under the leadership of the State Council, the State Education Commission shall be in charge of the national higher education work, and its main duties are:
(1) To implement the policies, laws and administrative regulations of the Party and the state concerning higher education, and formulate specific policies and rules for higher education work.
To direct and inspect the implementation by the provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, relevant departments under the State Council and institutions of higher education of the policies, laws and administrative regulations of the Party and the state concerning higher education.
(2) To organize the forecasting of demand for specialized personnel nationwide, formulate the national higher education development plan and annual enrollment plan, and adjust the structure and layout of higher education. To examine and approve the establishment, dissolution and adjustment of institutions of higher education (including higher specialized schools, the same below) and graduate schools. To formulate regulations on enrollment and graduate assignment, and compile the annual assignment plan for graduates to be uniformly allocated by the state.
(3) To formulate the standards for the establishment of institutions of higher education and graduate schools. To formulate the basic catalog of specialties and standards for specialty establishment in institutions of higher education, and organize the examination and approval of specialty establishment.
(4) To formulate, jointly with the relevant departments under the State Council, the principles for the management system and quota standards for capital construction investment, operating expenses, staffing, labor, and unified allocation of materials and equipment for higher education; to put forward guiding suggestions on the distribution plans for capital construction investment, education and scientific research funds, special funds, foreign exchange, and unified allocation of materials and equipment at the central level of higher education; to have control over the capital construction investment, operating expenses and staffing used for regulating the coordinated development of higher education and supporting the construction of key disciplines. To manage the foreign aid and loan work for higher education.
(5) To formulate rules and regulations for personnel management in institutions of higher education, and plan and organize the construction of the faculty and cadre teams in institutions of higher education. To organize and direct this work in institutions of higher education in accordance with the Provisions of the State Council on the Implementation of the System of Professional and Technical Post Appointment.
(6) To direct the ideological and political work, teaching work, physical education work, health work and general affairs work in institutions of higher education. To determine the length of schooling and training specifications for graduate students, undergraduate students and specialized course students. To formulate guiding teaching documents, plan and organize the compilation and review of teaching materials. To organize the inspection and evaluation of the educational quality of institutions of higher education.
(7) To direct and manage the enrollment and training of graduate students by institutions of higher education and scientific research institutions. To direct the work of degree conferral. To direct and manage the work of postdoctoral research stations in institutions of higher education.
(8) To direct the scientific research work of institutions of higher education. To cooperate with the competent departments for scientific and technological research of the state, organize the formulation of plans and management systems for scientific research in institutions of higher education. To promote collaboration and association between schools and scientific research, production, society and other departments, as well as inter-school cooperation.
(9) To direct and manage the work concerning students going abroad to study in institutions of higher education, students coming to China to study, and foreign intellectual assistance, and promote international academic exchanges and cooperation among institutions of higher education.
(10) To organize the provision of educational information, talent demand information and examination services to institutions of higher education.
(11) To uniformly direct various forms of adult higher education, formulate the development plan for adult higher education, and formulate and issue the annual enrollment plan. To formulate, jointly with the relevant departments under the State Council, the plan for continuing education.
(12) To directly manage a small number of institutions of higher education.

II. The relevant departments under the State Council shall, under the guidance of the State Education Commission, manage the institutions of higher education directly under them, and their main duties are:
(1) To implement the policies, laws and administrative regulations of the Party and the state concerning higher education.
(2) To organize the forecasting of demand for specialized personnel in their respective systems and industries, formulate development plans, annual enrollment plans and graduate assignment plans for the part to be assigned by themselves for the institutions of higher education directly under their management. To direct the enrollment and graduate assignment work.
(3) To examine the establishment, dissolution and adjustment of the institutions of higher education directly under their management and the establishment of specialties and the construction of key disciplines under those institutions, and submit applications or suggestions to the State Education Commission. To, upon entrustment by the State Education Commission and in accordance with the relevant provisions, examine and approve the addition and dissolution of specialties under the higher specialized schools directly under their management.
(4) To be responsible for the capital construction investment, unified allocation of materials and equipment, allocation of operating expense budgets and examination of final accounts for the institutions of higher education directly under their management.
(5) To direct the ideological and political work, teaching work, scientific research work and general affairs work of the institutions of higher education directly under their management. To appoint and remove the principal persons-in-charge of the institutions. To organize and direct this work in the institutions of higher education directly under their management in accordance with the Provisions of the State Council on the Implementation of the System of Professional and Technical Post Appointment.
(6) To, in accordance with the unified arrangements of the State Education Commission and jointly with the relevant provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government, organize the evaluation of the educational quality of corresponding specialties in institutions of higher education, and organize and plan the compilation and review of teaching materials for corresponding specialties.
(7) To direct and coordinate the production practice and social practice of students of institutions of higher education in their respective systems. To encourage relevant specialties and research institutions of institutions of higher education to participate in the scientific and technological development of their systems, and promote the connection between enterprises and schools.
(8) To encourage the institutions of higher education directly under their management to operate schools for the society, and implement joint school operation between their departments and relevant departments under the State Council, and between their departments and localities.
(9) To manage the adult higher education, professional training, continuing education and related work on compilation and review of teaching materials within their departments.

III. The people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall manage the institutions of higher education within their respective regions, and their main duties are:
(1) To be responsible for directing and inspecting the implementation by all institutions of higher education within their respective regions of the policies, laws and regulations of the Party and the state concerning higher education.
(2) To organize the forecasting of demand for specialized personnel in their respective regions, formulate development plans and annual enrollment plans for the institutions of higher education directly under their management, and organize and lead the enrollment and graduate assignment work. To examine the establishment, dissolution and adjustment of the institutions of higher education directly under their management and the establishment of specialties, and submit applications or suggestions to the State Education Commission. To, upon entrustment by the State Education Commission and in accordance with the relevant state provisions, examine and approve the addition and dissolution of specialties under the higher specialized schools directly under their management.
(3) To be responsible for the capital construction investment, unified allocation of materials and equipment, allocation of operating expense budgets and examination of final accounts for the institutions of higher education directly under their management.
(4) To direct the ideological and political work, teaching work, scientific research work and general affairs work of the institutions of higher education directly under their management. To appoint and remove the principal persons-in-charge of the institutions. To organize and direct this work in these institutions of higher education and in some institutions of higher education directly under the relevant departments of the State Council, in accordance with the Provisions of the State Council on the Implementation of the System of Professional and Technical Post Appointment. To assist the general affairs work of all institutions of higher education within their respective regions in gradually achieving socialization.
(5) To organize inter-school cooperation and exchange of experiences among all institutions of higher education within their respective regions, and conduct inspection and evaluation of educational quality. To direct and coordinate the production practice and social practice of students of institutions of higher education within their respective regions.
(6) To encourage all institutions of higher education within their respective regions to operate schools for the society and to conduct joint school operation across regions and departments. Under the guidance of the State Education Commission, to coordinate and organize pilot programs of joint school operation for institutions of higher education directly under the relevant departments of the State Council, on the condition that investment, funds and talent demand are guaranteed. To promote the association and collaboration between institutions of higher education and departments such as scientific research and production.
(7) To manage the adult higher education under their respective regions.

IV. The expansion of the management authority of institutions of higher education and the enhancement of their ability to meet the needs of economic and social development shall mainly consist of:
(1) On the premise of ensuring the completion of the task of training personnel assigned by the state, may carry out inter-department and inter-regional joint school operation according to the proportion prescribed by the state, and accept students entrusted for training and self-paying students. May put forward suggestions on the plan for the source of enrollment, enroll students in accordance with the relevant state provisions, and handle and eliminate unqualified students. Shall implement the graduate assignment plan assigned by the state, formulate the graduate assignment scheme, and recommend some graduates to the employing units.
(2) On the premise of implementing the policy of running schools with diligence and thrift and complying with the state financial system, may arrange for the use of the annual operating expenses verified by the competent department in accordance with the budget management principle of "lump-sum use, no supplementation for overspending, retention for use of savings, and self-balance".
The income obtained from accepting students entrusted for training and self-paying students, running special training courses for cadres, correspondence education, evening universities, and providing social technical services and consulting shall be arranged for use in the development of undertakings, collective welfare and individual rewards in accordance with the relevant state provisions.
(3) In accordance with the overall design mission statement, overall plan, long-term and annual capital construction plans approved by the competent department, and on the premise of implementing investment lump-sum to the competent department, may independently select the best design and construction units. On the premise of ensuring the realization of investment returns, may, after approval by the competent department, independently examine and approve design documents and adjust the long-term and annual capital construction plans. For lump-sum investment, the savings may be retained for use, and overspending shall not be supplemented.
(4) In accordance with the authority for cadre management, may, based on the prescribed cadre conditions, staffing and selection procedures, have the president nominate and report for the appointment and removal of vice presidents; may appoint and remove other administrative personnel at all levels; may appoint and dismiss teachers and dismiss staff members.
(5) Approved institutions of higher education may, in accordance with the relevant state provisions, assess the qualifications for the position of associate professor, and a few qualified institutions of higher education may assess the qualifications for the position of professor; may examine and approve the disciplines and specialties for awarding master's degrees, and add doctoral supervisors.
(6) In accordance with the educational policies of the Party and the state, the length of schooling and training specifications, may adjust the service direction of specialties according to social needs, formulate teaching plans (training programs), teaching syllabuses, select teaching materials, and carry out reforms of teaching content and methods.
(7) On the premise of ensuring the completion of the scientific research tasks assigned by the state, may independently decide to participate in the bidding for scientific research projects, undertake scientific research tasks entrusted by other units, and carry out technical services and consulting for the society.
Under circumstances where no increase in capital construction investment, operating expenses and staffing by the competent department is required, may independently decide to establish separately or jointly with other units scientific research institutions or consortia of teaching, scientific research and production. May accept funding from enterprises and units and decide on the priority of its use.
(8) Within the scope of the state's foreign affairs policies and relevant provisions, shall actively carry out foreign exchange activities. For funds raised by the school itself (including retained foreign exchange), after approval by the higher competent department that the counterpart funding is acceptable, or within the limit of funds and foreign exchange allocated by the competent department, may decide on the personnel for academic exchanges going abroad and coming to China. Approved schools may be responsible for the political review of personnel going abroad.
